title: SPA studio rail + Chat blank after CARD-251 forge.js syntax break
root_cause_detail: 7ca3f9d CARD-251 stripped template-literal backticks in src/web/static/modules/studios/forge.js (paths became /api/...//sandbox regex; SyntaxError: Invalid regular expression flags). app.js statically imported forge.js so the module graph never evaluated; initApp did not run; chrome HTML loaded (empty Chat placeholder + empty rail) — CARD-237 class.
fix: dynamic-import Forge from app.js so one studio parse failure cannot blank Chat/rail
app_js_v_served_note: src/web/app.py rewrites app.js?v= to request-time timestamp
proof: restart_serve orphan-kill; served forge.js parses; no pageerror; Chat window 720x560 composer live (empty placeholder gone); Education dock+window 760x560 Ask attached; rail icons=5
design_room_one_liner: P0 empty-rail was a tip regression: CARD-251 stripped forge.js template literals (SyntaxError) and static-import blanked initApp; fixed on feat/self-scaffold-queue-e2e-255 @ 4b7f8f1 — rail+Chat+Education live; HOLD grok merge.
